policy: Only explicit reviewed phrase-to-widget FontObject contracts are checked. Review producer source, callers, template inheritance and later font changes before refreshing sha256. Buttons bind every declared font state. Font objects resolve through the pinned client font mappings; translated text never selects a font. Dynamic game data, tooltips, menus, chat and unlisted or uncertain consumers have no coverage claim. Empty bindings pin reviewed dependencies or exclusions, not glyph coverage.

producers.review: Read Text, Line, Headers, Refresh, Choose and Attach. The title uses GameFontNormalLarge and the empty-state line uses GameFontDisableSmall. PanelTopTabButtonTemplate inherits the normal GameFontNormalSmall, highlight GameFontHighlightSmall and disabled GameFontHighlightSmall from PanelTabButtonTemplate (Blizzard_SharedXML/Mainline/SharedUIPanelTemplates.xml). PanelTemplates_SelectTab also sets the disabled font to GameFontHighlightSmall. The Shopping list action still inherits SharedButtonSmallTemplate and its three font states from Blizzard_SharedXML/Shared/Button/ThreeSliceButtonTemplate.xml. Row cells, headers, summary, footer and per-tab empty lines take dynamic data or text from other producers and are excluded.
